name: night-garden
description: A live night-forest wallpaper for macOS: moss, moths and fireflies rendered in real time, built on Desktop Habitats.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && for f in scenes/night-garden/src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for f in scenes/night-garden/tests/*.mjs; do node --import ./scenes/night-garden/tests/support/register.mjs "$f" || exit 1; done
